pages.title: Photographic Plate
pages.text: A glass plate coated with a light-sensitive emulsion set in gelatin. Left open under the sky for an hour, it records stars far too faint for any eye.

Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Derelict Station chests.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Avogadro Record, Burst Afterglow Crystal, Calcite, Cepheid Standard Candle, Deep Sky Plate, Einstein Ring Lens, Fluorite Boule, Garnet Boule and more.
